name: close-grip-pin-press
instructions:
1. Set the safeties in a rack to just above chest height while supine.
2. Lie flat on a bench and set your hands at shoulder width.
3. Set your shoulder blades by pinching them together and driving them into the bench.
4. Take a deep breath and allow your spotter to help you with the lift off to maintain tightness through your upper back.
5. Let the weight settle and ensure your upper back remains tight after lift off.
6. Inhale and allow the bar to descend slowly by unlocking the elbows.
7. Lower the bar in a straight line to the pins and pause for 2-3 seconds.
8. Push the bar back up in a straight line by pressing yourself into the bench, driving your feet into the floor for leg drive, and extending the elbows.
9. Repeat from the pins for the desired number of repetitions.
